title: fix(ui): dashboard reports are cut off and catch swipes on phones
body:
Part of #199401 (proposal 1).

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: on a phone, dashboard reports are cut off and scroll inside small boxes, so swipes over them get stuck instead of scrolling the dashboard.

## User Impact

User impact: on a phone, native reports and session progress cards show all their content, and swiping anywhere on the dashboard scrolls the dashboard. A card's saved size is still the smallest it gets, so making a card bigger with the resize corner or a size preset works as before. Website, Browser, custom HTML and other plugin widgets keep their saved height.

Desktop does not change, including the dashboard panel docked beside chat (448 px wide): every card keeps the size the user gave it, and content that does not fit scrolls inside the card, as on `main`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Without this, stacked cards keep the row height they have on the 12-column desktop grid: a report pinned at the default size (6 × 4) gets a 220 px window for content that stacks to over 1,000 px at phone width, so it becomes an inner scroller. In the phone layout (the app's shared `PHONE_LAYOUT_QUERY` breakpoint), when the board stacks its cards, the grid rows are at least 56 px and grow with content-fitting cards: reports and session progress grow to their content but never below their saved size, and every other card keeps its saved height because its body is size-contained. The core widget registry marks which kinds fit their content. The rules are limited to the phone layout because on desktop users size cards to compose their dashboard, and scrolling inside a card is intended there.

Total Control UI CSS on `main` is over its cap, so a change may add at most 64 B. The phone layout rules add more than that, so this also removes two new-session styles that no page has rendered since #197820 (the project search status line and the browser list loading line).

## Evidence

Desktop, before (`main`) and after (this PR), 1440 × 900, same report (an 8-row table at the default 6 × 4 size). The dashboard area is pixel-identical in both: the card stays 260 px tall and its table scrolls inside it.

Dashboard panel docked beside chat (448 px):

![Desktop side panel, before and after: the same 260 px report card with its table cut off at Issue 5 and scrolling inside, identical in both](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/34e8e85da59be03c998cd6a6c474bebe6ce5d219/images/2026/11/217a9d1f-63bb-414a-b077-cbb93c4e0ba7.png)

Expanded dashboard panel (1098 px):

![Expanded desktop dashboard, before and after: the same half-width report card with its table cut off at Issue 6, identical in both](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/34e8e85da59be03c998cd6a6c474bebe6ce5d219/images/2026/11/d50158e1-bf10-4575-8a81-e1b0cd36dca0.png)

Phone, before (`main`) and after (this PR), 390 × 844, same report, panel expanded so the whole card is in view. Before: the table stops at Issue 5 and the rest scrolls inside the card. After: all 8 rows show.

![Phone, before and after: on main the report is cut off at Issue 5; with this PR all eight rows are visible](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/34e8e85da59be03c998cd6a6c474bebe6ce5d219/images/2026/11/aec84921-9824-486b-ae17-ed82f04cf98f.png)

Before and after at iPhone width, mocked Control UI with synthetic data, same scroll positions. Before: the Release status metrics are cut off and the Blockers table shows one row in a box. After: both show in full.

Before:

![Before: on a phone, the Release status report is cut off and the Blockers table shows one row inside a small scrolling box](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/1447105c8f2657beaaecd8997c9b9d09d10f8110/images/2026/11/5915ddef-58be-4e15-bcc7-e4c15ccfe9d7.png)

After:

![After: the Release status report and the whole Blockers table are visible, and the dashboard scrolls as one page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/1447105c8f2657beaaecd8997c9b9d09d10f8110/images/2026/11/5e968069-9468-4528-858f-f66e5722eeef.png)

Swipe over a long report at phone width (393 × 852, Chromium with touch emulation, mocked Control UI with synthetic data). Left is `main`, right is this PR. Each side gets the same three upward touch swipes, each starting on the Blockers report (checked with `elementFromPoint` before every swipe). The yellow dot is the finger. The yellow bar is a test overlay that reads the dashboard's and the report's scroll offsets live.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/41535a8f-f975-4ab0-8f81-456e6f1e8e51

![Mid-swipe at phone width. Left, main: the dashboard stays at 330 px while the Blockers report scrolls 498 px inside its card. Right, this PR: the dashboard has scrolled to 828 px and the report has no inner scroll](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/2d4340bac75584185ca0f64ee5e289bd5c74edbb/images/2026/11/4031ee28-9c2d-426e-aa82-833368dd122f.png)

Scroll offsets captured after each swipe:

| | `main`: dashboard | `main`: report inside its card | This PR: dashboard | This PR: report inside its card |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Start | 330 px | 0 px | 330 px | 0 px |
| Swipe 1 | 330 px | 249 px | 579 px | 0 px |
| Swipe 2 | 330 px | 498 px | 828 px | 0 px |
| Swipe 3 | 330 px | 747 px | 1,077 px | 0 px |

Resizing on a phone (390 px), checked in the same mocked Control UI with a report saved at the default size (6 × 4): Resize > XL grows the card from 262 to 532 px, and dragging the resize corner down grows it to 532 px and saves 6 × 8.

Tests:
- New end-to-end test in `ui/src/e2e/native-report-widget.e2e.test.ts` (390 × 844 touch viewport, default-size report with an 8-row table, real touch swipe): fails on `main` with 145 px of the report hidden, passes with this change. About 2–5 s.
- New end-to-end test in the same file (1440 × 900 desktop, the same report in the 448 px docked panel): checks the report keeps its saved size and scrolls inside. Fails on the previous head of this PR, which fitted reports in the desktop panel too; passes now.
- Board browser tests 25/25.
- UI end-to-end typecheck, oxlint, stylelint and formatting clean.
- `pnpm ui:check-performance:base` against `main` (ade4216): total CSS +46 B gzip, +55 B raw, within the 64 B allowance.
- The two existing tests in the same end-to-end file can time out opening the report's link in a new tab on a heavily loaded machine; the same happens on `main`.

Not run: a physical iPhone or iOS Safari, and a live Gateway with a real agent (the mocked Control UI and the end-to-end suite's mock Gateway were used).
